Equipment
Use the tabs to look at your character's equipment and that of your mounts.

You can place the appropriate items into these slots. When the slot is empty, a tooltip will explain which item type can be put there. The regeneration time varies depending on the equipped armor. Cloth armor offers less physical protection but you will be able to execute combat arts in quicker succession.

Selling

Placing an item on this icon will sell it immediately. You will receive less money than you would at a merchant, but at least you will have room in your inventory again.

Forging
If your character has learned the "Blacksmith" skill you will be able to open the forge menu here.

Overview
This is an overview of all bonuses and penalties that are currently influencing your character.

Set Bonuses

When parts of your equipement belong to a special item set, they can unlock certain bonuses. These will be displayed on this screen.

Orb

You can equip your character in three different areas: the equipment screen, the weapon slots and the orb.
The orb is for relics that offer you protection against non-physical damage types.

Mounts
If you own a horse or a character specific mount you can equip it via the mount tab. Under that tab you can also select, which mount you would like to use.
